issues_flagged.title: Type III / CRF asymmetry — Type III is a SUBSET of the CRF population, not a synonym
issues_flagged.detail: Dabrowska et al. 2013 (quote_key 4940077_5b783374) measure P(CRF mRNA+ | Type III) = 0.95 in rat BNSTALG. The converse, P(Type III | CRF+), is not measured anywhere in the corpus. Silberman et al. 2013 (quote_key 16233294_39d761a0) report AT LEAST FOUR electrophysiologically separable subtypes among identified mouse BNST CRF neurons. Therefore bnst_crf_neuron must NOT be described as 'the Type III population', and the Type III class is modelled as the separate subset node bnstalg_type_iii_crf_neuron.
issues_flagged.action_taken: Recorded as an explicit caveat in both nodes' notes and in bnst_crf_neuron.electrophysiology.description; no synonymy asserted.

issues_flagged.title: Nguyen direction vs Companion converse — P(GABAergic|CRF+) vs P(CRF+|GABAergic)
issues_flagged.detail: Companion et al. 2018 quote_key 53099693_f0c5c390 states 'within the dlBNST, about 98% of CRF+ neurons are GABAergic (Nguyen et al., 2016)' — i.e. P(GABAergic | CRF+) ~ 0.98. The SAME paper, quote_key 53099693_aa80db1b, states the converse: '98% of GABAergic neurons in the dlBNST entail a CRF phenotype', i.e. P(CRF+ | GABAergic) ~ 0.98. The ASTA report reproduced both directions. These are not equivalent and cannot both hold: the converse would make CRF+ cells almost the entire dlBNST GABAergic population, which is inconsistent with the peptide-defined BNST mosaic (Pdyn, Penk, Nts, Npy, Pnoc, Sst, Tac1, Tac2, Avp; Pkcd/Drd1 in ovBNST — quote_key 231848933_2ec86aed) and with CRH+ cells being a minority of adBNST neurons.
issues_flagged.resolution: Only the Nguyen direction (P(GABAergic | CRF+) ~ 98%) is asserted in the KB. quote_key 53099693_aa80db1b is tagged in references.json with claim 'contradiction_converse_direction' and is NOT used as a source for any property.
issues_flagged.action_taken: Documented in bnst_crf_neuron.nt_type sources[].notes and in node notes.

issues_flagged.title: Oxt-negative: real, but scoped to the PVN contrast
issues_flagged.detail: Dabrowska et al. 2013 (quote_key 4940077_383bf7ef) report 0/19 Type III BNSTALG CRF neurons co-expressing Oxt, versus 83% of PVN parvocellular CRF neurons, and conversely 95% OTR+ in Type III versus 0% in PVN. This establishes BNST CRF neurons as a distinct extra-hypothalamic CRF class but does NOT discriminate among BNST cell types — no BNST population is reported as Oxt+.
issues_flagged.action_taken: Oxt recorded as a negative marker with an explicit SCOPE LIMITATION note on the marker source and in node notes. Downstream mapping should not score Oxt-negativity as discriminative within BNST.

issues_flagged.title: Type II subdivides; Type I and III do not
issues_flagged.detail: Hierarchical clustering of ion-channel alpha-subunit transcripts indicates Type I and Type III are genetically homogeneous populations, whereas Type II comprises three genetically distinct subgroups. This supports treating Type III as a coherent class.
issues_flagged.action_taken: Stated in electrophysiology.description; strengthens the case for the new node.

issues_flagged.title: No dedicated dlBNST CRF transcriptomic cluster
